source: Original Sega Genesis USA ROM; no DOS campaign data

introText.text: From the dark world of Giedi Prime the savage House Harkonnen has spread across the universe.A cruel people, we Harkonnen are ruthless towards both friend and foe in our fanatical pursuit of power.Do you wish to join House Harkonnen?

missions.name: Mission 1
missions.nameSource: UI ordinal: no native password exists for first mission

briefing.text: I am the Mentat, Radnor.For your first test you will be expected to produce 1000 credits, and not a granule less.You may earn credits by harvesting spice, and will need to build a refinery to convert spice to credits.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: You have pleased me.Continue to serve me well, and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: You are beneath my contempt.Do you know what happens to those who have failed House Harkonnen?
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: First build concrete slabs, and then build a Windtrap and place it upon the concrete.Do the same for a refinery so that you can reach your quota of 1000 credits.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: House Harkonnen will now allow you to take command in a more dangerous area.You will encounter the worthless Atreides in this region.Whether you eliminate them or accumulate 2700 credits in spice, that is up to you.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Again you have pleased me.You remind me of myself in my youth.You may indeed have true Harkonnen blood coursing through your veins!
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: I cannot believe that you were incapable of accumulating your quota.It was a simple task.I suggest you do not try my patience further.
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: Once you have an Outpost, you will be able to build a Barracks which produces our elite Troopers.I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: The despised Ordos in this region are harvesting spice that rightfully belongs to the House Harkonnen.Destroy the Ordos installations in this area and assert control in the name of House Harkonnen.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Congratulations.You are making progress.Several of my associates have expressed pessimism concerning your abilities.I am glad that you have proved them wrong.
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: I knew it!Several of my associates had expressed confidence, but I knew that you were too weak to be a Harkonnen commander!
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: You need to build a Vehicle Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: One small victory does not win the war.Another region has the misfortune to be infested with vermin from House Ordos, and now you must face the disgusting Ordos again.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Well done.The Ordos dogs make amusing noises when they die, do they not?Indeed, what good is our life if we cannot enjoy the simple pleasures?
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: Is this the way you repay my faith in you?Such a serious loss could only have been deliberate!You are unfit to clean our latrines, much less command our glorious Troopers!
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: The addition of tanks to your forces is essential to your victory in this region.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: So, the Emperor was helping the Ordos in your last mission.Nevertheless, House Atreides has grown stronger due to our negligence, and must now be taught a lesson.You will remove all the Atreides from this region.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: In appreciation for your recent performance, I will now allow you to resume the struggle with the Ordos.At least they will put up a fight worthy of our Troopers.
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: Perhaps you miss your mother?I am worried about you and cannot let you progress further until you have proved yourself against the Atreides.
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: You are to proceed into yet another region dominated by those pesky Ordos.I expect you to overcome this troublesome group.We have established a good reputation on this planet.Do not embarrass me now!
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: The victor`s laurels fit you well my son!I may even refer other aspirants to study your tactics.
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: How could you manage such a defeat?I may have to slit your throat myself just to calm down!
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: Reports of new Atreides activity require that I send you immediately back to the front line.You do not seem to enjoy rest and relaxation anyway.I think you would prefer to crush the Atreides.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Congratulations.It is a pleasure to see the weak Atreides dealt with so severely!
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: Your failure has caused me no end of embarrassment.It will not happen again!
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: The Devastator is a powerful ally against enemy forces.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: A commander of your status may require relaxation occasionally, but I expect an even greater efficiency on your part.Both Atreides and Ordos forces exist in this region, and all must be eliminated!
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Although praise may be due, serving House Harkonnen is reward enough!We will speak fondly of you forever!
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: Guards!How did this weakling get in here?If this happens again, I will personally dissect several of you!
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: Utilize Rocket turrets as a defense against Ornithopters.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: We have been deceived!All have conspired against us, and so all must die!Destroy all of the Emperor`s forces.He has treated us poorly, and must not live another day!
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: You have served me, I mean House Harkonnen, well.Not only have you won a great victory, but you have made our enemies suffer!Rejoice, for Dune is finally ours forever!
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: Your defects must have been inherited.Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

introText.text: House Atreides has a long tradition of being fair and just administrators.Our people are loyal, hard working, and peaceable.Do you wish to join House Atreides?

missions.name: Mission 1
missions.nameSource: UI ordinal: no native password exists for first mission

briefing.text: Greetings, I am your Mentat Cyril.Together we will purge this planet of the foulness of the other Houses.The High Command wishes you to produce 1000 credits.You may earn credits by building a refinery and harvesting spice.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Congratulations!I knew that you would achieve your goal with very little trouble.I look forward to assisting you in future missions.
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: This is very disappointing.We had such high hopes for you.We must insist that you try again.
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: First build concrete slabs, and then build a Windtrap and place it upon the concrete.Do the same for a refinery so that you can reach your quota of 1000 credits.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: Greetings, I am honored to see you again.You are now required to either produce 2700 credits in a new harvesting area or remove the Ordos base in this region.Good luck!
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Well done!Our effort to maintain fair play on this planet is opposed by both the Ordos and the Harkonnen.This region will help us greatly in our efforts.
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: The loss of this region to the Ordos will hurt House Atreides greatly.Please try harder next time.The seriousness of your mission cannot be overemphasized!
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: If you have an Outpost, build a Barracks in order to produce soldiers.I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: The battle with the other Houses has intensified, and we are now forced to engage in some selected offensive maneuvers.The Harkonnen are being extremely troublesome in your next region, and we must ask that you remove their presence from the area.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Hurrah!Although I prefer defense, a fine offensive against such a deserving foe as the Harkonnen is a joy to behold.House Atreides thanks you for your efforts!
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: It is a cruel world, is it not?I`m not sure if I was expecting divine intervention, but as I watched your defeat I could not help thinking how unfair it was!
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: You need to build a Vehicle Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: Your demonstration of military skills now forces us to assign you to another offensive campaign against House Harkonnen.They have continued to attack our peaceful harvesters, and must be removed from the area!
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Well done!No task seems too difficult for you.The Harkonnen will think twice before attacking our harvesters again!
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: Although I understand the problems confronting you, I will confess that I am disappointed by your defeat.I am not sure what went wrong, but please do not let it happen again!
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: The addition of tanks in your forces is essential to your victory in this region.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: The rules seem to have changed.The Emperor himself has been aiding the efforts of our competitors!As a part of our new strategy, we must ask that you eliminate the treacherous Ordos forces that presently control this region.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Congratulations again!There seems to be no limit to your talents.I have to think that some divine force motivated your decision to serve within House Atreides.
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: This defeat of yours will not look good in my reports.I am not sure how much longer we can afford to support you.
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: As the battle for this planet intensifies, all efforts must be taken to ensure our success.Once again, we must call upon you to destroy our enemies in a troubled sector.House Harkonnen must be taught a lesson.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Hurrah!We have them on the run now, and it`s all because of you.Your successes have been remarkable!Are you sure you didn`t graduate from one of the intergalactic military academies?
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: There is a time for excuses, but this is not it!You have no choice but to apply yourself more diligently during your next assignment.
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: The battle goes well, but there is no time to relax.We have an urgent need for you to subdue all Ordos forces in this region promptly.We are counting on you.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Excellent!Your skill seems to improve with each assignment, and your exploits give great confidence to those on the home front.Keep up the good work!
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: My goodness, what an awful defeat!If you fail at your next assignment we will have to seriously consider sending you home!
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: The Sonic Tank is a powerful ally against enemy troops and structures.
hints.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

briefing.text: Although you have earned a well deserved rest, I`m afraid we need to send you back into the field immediately.Both Ordos and Harkonnen forces have been spotted in this region, and now must be removed completely.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: A masterful victory!Frankly, we would not be able to remain on Dune without your military guidance.We have come to rely completely on you sir, and cannot imagine further success without you!
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: A defeat is never welcome, but this loss is particularly devastating!All of our efforts may soon prove futile unless you can provide a victory in your next campaign!
defeat.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

hints.text: Utilize Rocket turrets as a defense against Ornithopters.

briefing.text: Your next assignment will determine the entire outcome of our efforts here on Dune.You are instructed to subdue Emperor Frederick`s forces.All of our hopes and dreams are riding with you, and we humbly beg of you to provide one final victory for our noble House Atreides.
briefing.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

victory.text: Good Morning, your lordship, and congratulations!You showed great compassion in dealing with a distasteful task.Together we have succeeded in purging this planet of the foulness of the other Houses.
victory.encoding: literal original ASCII, NUL terminated; no translation or rewritten punctuation

defeat.text: Your defects must have been inherited.Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.

briefing.text: We find the activities of Atreides troops in this region inconvenient.Please remove this obstacle.We cannot allow the mythical value of fair play to impede our progress.

victory.text: Excellent!There were rumors that some sort of moral objections would hinder your effectiveness.I am glad to see that you have risen above these petty sensitivities.

defeat.text: Your clumsy management has cost us dearly!I suggest you rid yourself of all outside interests and devote yourself completely to your next assignment!

victory.text: A masterful victory, but be cautious!Your reputation will now precede you in future engagements, and you may find your foes better prepared for your tactics.

defeat.text: How could you possibly fail so quickly?My grandmother could command more efficiently than you!Get back out there and show some initiative, or stop wasting my time!

hints.text: The addition of tanks to your forces is essential to your victory in this region.

briefing.text: What?The Sarduakar were aiding our enemies during your last mission?I will need to look into this.Although the Harkonnen commanders are laughably stupid, their military strength is a threat to us in this area.They must be eliminated as soon as possible.

victory.text: Congratulations would be in order, but we expect these results when you are in charge.Your continued success brings honor to your family, and all of us in House Ordos.

defeat.text: You bungling fool!Did you expect your enemies to run away at the mere sight of you?Remember: your brain will win the war, not your bullets!

hints.text: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.

briefing.text: The Atreides have become far too vocal in this sector, and whine constantly about their rights.We Ordos do not have the leisure of pointless conversation, and must ask that you eliminate this distraction.

defeat.text: Do you instruct your troops to fire randomly into the air?Is there any plan to your idiotic maneuvers?I suggest that you no longer allow your dog to assist in managing your assignments!

victory.text: Excellent!You have won a great victory for House Ordos.Doesn`t inflicting such a humiliating defeat make your breakfast taste better?

defeat.text: Your failure could not have been timed more poorly!What status and bargaining power can we maintain when you display such ineptitude in the field?

regionEvidence.consumer: $25FA8..25FC2 maps (house,mission) to one fixed territory identifier; $264F8 calls one canonical scenario, no branch variant argument
regionEvidence.briefingChoice: Native PROCEED/ADVICE selects mission instructions or original hints, not a different scenario/map. No DOS region graph is substituted.

progressContract.owner: Browser storage managed separately by host
progressContract.unlock: Only one verified original victory edge for an armed played mission; boot, loading, scene changes, password validation and defeat never unlock
progressContract.replay: Host may request any previously unlocked mission; original loader creates its scenario state. Browser save slot is not erased by this adapter.
progressContract.missionOne: No invented password. Uses ordinary native new-house flow.

limitations: Native start regression covers all27 scenario starts; it is not a full campaign playthrough.
Mission outcome fixtures may deliberately satisfy native win/lose conditions offline; they do not claim user-earned completion.
ROM and translated instruction bytes remain unchanged; only native menu intent and campaign selector entry points are adapted.
